title: ContextMint | Local AI coding assistant
description: ContextMint is a local AI coding assistant and a decision-control plane. Ask, Plan, and Agent on your machine, with evidence and human approval before anything writes. Coming soon.

hero.subAfter: on your machine, with evidence and human approval before anything writes. Coming soon.
hero.pill: AI CODING ASSISTANT · DECISION-CONTROL PLANE · COMING SOON

finalCta.title: Start coding locally. Add team control when you need it.
finalCta.line1: A solo developer installs Engine and the extension and starts in VS Code.
finalCta.line2: A small company or enterprise adds a shared server, SSO, and human approval.

audiences.title: Solo developer, or a team
audiences.lead: One product. A solo developer starts frictionless on one machine and can turn on controlled checks. A small company or enterprise adds a shared server, SSO, and an admin lock so the team cannot change posture or cloud.

paths.title: Solo developer
paths.text: Install Engine and the VS Code extension. The default is frictionless. Turn on controlled checks when you want evidence review and patch approval. No signup, shared server, or SSO.
points: Ask how the codebase fits together, plan the change, and let Agent propose it
Frictionless by default; controlled when you turn on evidence review and patch approval
Optional bring-your-own-key cloud, off until you turn it on
Code and the index stay on your machine

paths.title: Small company / enterprise
paths.text: Everything in the solo path. An admin can lock posture and cloud so a developer cannot change them.
points: Shared on-prem server for the team
Admin lock for frictionless or controlled, and for bring-your-own-key cloud
Quality map and operator audit for the team

pilotNow.title: On a coding day
pilotNow.introRest: Ask how the repo fits together and plan a change across the files it touches. Frictionless by default. Turn on approval when you want the patch to wait.

cards.title: Ask, Plan, Agent
cards.text: Explain the repo, write a plan for the change, or propose the patch. Approval waits for you when controlled checks are on.

cards.title: Change scope
cards.text: Work spans the files a change touches, with citations from the indexed workspace.

cards.title: Review the change
cards.text: Review a file, branch, feature, or flow, then decide what to accept.

cards.title: Context Lens
cards.text: See the retrieved evidence and the chosen model before the assistant answers.

footer.sharedServerText: Shared on-prem API server path for regulated pilots —
footer.byokText: Optional BYOK cloud routing is off by default.

problem.title: The Problem Isn't Code Generation. It's Trust.
problem.lead: AI creates changes faster than organizations can review them with evidence. That is a board-level risk — not a tooling gap.

whyNow.title: The Bottleneck Moved
whyNow.lead: Code generation is no longer the constraint. Evidence and human oversight are.

before.label: Before AI
before.body: Humans generated code slower than organizations could review it.

after.label: After AI
after.body: AI generates code faster than organizations can verify with evidence.

decisionControl.title: A coding assistant with a record
decisionControl.lead: Ask, Plan, and Agent use the indexed workspace. Context Lens shows the evidence. Patch preview waits for your approval — on your machine, or on a shared server for a team.
